questions.question: A series is given, with one word missing. Choose the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series. isobar, artist, statute, teapot, other, ?
questions.questionHtml:
A series is given, with one word missing. Choose the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

isobar, artist, statute, teapot, other, ?
questions.solution:
The next word always starts with the last two letter of the previous word.

Isobar → artist → statute → teapot → other → ? (er)

Here the last word is ‘Other’ and the last two letter of the same is ‘er’, hence the next word will start from letters ‘er’.

Hence, answer is erect.

questions.question: The weights of 4 boxes are 100, 70, 50 and 90 kilograms. Which of the following cannot be the total weight, in kilograms, of any combination of these boxes and in a combination a box can be used only once?
questions.questionHtml: The weights of 4 boxes are 100, 70, 50 and 90 kilograms. Which of the following cannot be the total weight, in kilograms, of any combination of these boxes and in a combination a box can be used only once?
questions.solution:
If the weight of all the boxes are added: 100 + 70 + 50 + 90 = 310 kg

If the weight of the 1st, 2nd and the 4th box is added: 100 + 70 + 90 = 260 kg

If the weight of 2nd, 3rd, and the 4th box is added: 70 + 50 + 90 = 210 kg

Hence, by elimination method we can eliminate three options i.e. 310, 260 and 210.

Therefore, 230 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Divit's birthday is on Friday 30 th June. On what day of the week will be Samar's Birthday in the same year if Samar was born on 15 th November?
questions.questionHtml: Divit's birthday is on Friday 30<sup>th</sup> June. On what day of the week will be Samar's Birthday in the same year if Samar was born on 15<sup>th</sup> November?
questions.solution:
Number of days from 30th June to 15th November are 138. Also, when 138 is divided by 7 it gives the remainder 5 and 5th day after Friday is Wednesday.

Hence, Wednesday is the correct answer.

questions.question: If REGAINS is coded as QDFZHMR, then how will PRY be coded as?

questions.solution:
Logic: If we look at the pattern closely we will see that each letter of the second word is the alphabet that comes just before the letter which is in the first word at same position.

R → Q; E → D; G → F and so on.

Similarly

P → O

R → Q

Y → X

Hence, OQX is the correct answer.

questions.solution:
It is an alternative series and 8/3 is subtracted from each term to get the alternate term.

3 - 8/3 = 1/3 → 1/3 - 8/3 = -7/3

Similarly,

5/3 - 8/3 = -3/3 = -1 → -1 - 8/3 = -11/3

Hence the correct answer is -1.

questions.question: "United Nations Organization" is listed in the ________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.questionHtml: "United Nations Organization" is listed in the ________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
Option 1 is correct, i.e. Union.

  • The Union List or List-I is a list of 97 items given in Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India on which Parliament has exclusive power to legislate.
  • It contains references to all matters which bring the Union into relation with any foreign country, Diplomatic, consular and trade representation, United Nations Organisation, Participation in international conferences, etc.

Seventh Schedule of the Indian constitution gives allocation of powers and functions between Union & States. It contains 3 lists:-

1. Union List (For central Govt) 100 Subjects (originally 97).

2. States List (Powers of State Govt) 61 subjects  (originally 66). 

3.Concurrent List (Both Union & States) 52 subjects (originally 47).

questions.question: 1. The author of the novel 'Darkness at Noon' is Victor LaValle'. 2. The author of the novel 'The Great Gatsby' is F. Scott Fitzgerald. 3. The author of the novel 'The Sound and the Fury' is L. Ron Hubbard. Which of the statements given above are not correct?
questions.questionHtml:
1. The author of the novel 'Darkness at Noon' is Victor LaValle'.

2. The author of the novel 'The Great Gatsby' is F. Scott Fitzgerald.

3. The author of the novel 'The Sound and the Fury' is L. Ron Hubbard.

Which of the statements given above are not correct?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 1 and 3.

Key Points

  • ‘Darkness at Noon’ is a novel by Hungarian-born British novelist Arthur Koestler, first published in 1940.
  • 'The Sound and the Fury’ is a novel written by the American author William Faulkner.

Additional Information

  • The Great Gatsby is a 1925 novel by American writer F. Scott Fitzgerald. 
  • The novel was inspired by a youthful romance Fitzgerald had with socialite Ginevra King, and the riotous parties he attended on Long Island's North Shore in 1922.
  • During World War II, the novel experienced an abrupt surge in popularity when the Council on Books in Wartime distributed free copies to American soldiers serving overseas. 
  • The Great Gatsby is widely considered to be a literary masterwork and a contender for the title of the Great American Novel.​

questions.solution: 3D optical data storage is any form of optical data storage in which information can be recorded or read with three-dimensional resolution (as opposed to the two-dimensional resolution afforded, for example, by CD). questions.questionHtml: If the orbit of a planet is an ellipse then what is the point at which the Sun is located called?
questions.solution: An ellipse with a small eccentricity, like 0.1 or 0.2, is almost as round as a circle. There are two points inside of an ellipse called the "foci" ("foci" is the plural form of "focus"). The larger objects is at one of the two foci. For example, the Sun is at one of the foci of Earth's elliptical orbit.

questions.question: The sliding friction is ________ than the static friction.
questions.questionHtml: The sliding friction is ________ than the static friction.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e Smaller

​Friction Force: It is a kind of resisting force that acts between two contact bodies to avoid relative motion between them.
  • It is formed due to the close interaction of charged particles at the surface of the bodies due to electromagnetic forces.
  • It always acts opposite to the motion of the body.
  • Mathematically it is represented as Friction force = μ N.
  • Where N = normal force = m × g
  • Normal force: It is a force that is exerted by the surface perpendicular to the body. It is a component of the contact force.

Static friction acts on objects when they are resting on a surface. It must always be overcome to start a body moving. 

Sliding friction term refers to the resistance created by two objects sliding against each other. This can also be called kinetic friction. Sliding friction is intended to stop an object from moving.

Rolling friction is friction that acts on objects when they are rolling over a surface. Rolling friction is much weaker than sliding friction or static friction.

ΜRolling < μSliding < μStatic

μr < μk < μS

Explanation:

The sliding friction is less or smaller than static friction because of the interlocking of irregularities in the two surfaces. When the object starts sliding, the contact points on its surface do not get enough time to lock into the contact points on the floor. So the sliding friction is slightly less than the static friction.

If a very gentle force in the horizontal direction is given to an object it does not move. It is because of the opposing force exerted by the surface on the object which resists its motion.

This force is called the frictional force which always opposes the relative motion between an object and the surface where it is placed. If the force applied is increased, the object moves after a certain limit.

Static friction is the force that opposes the initiation of motion of an object on the surface. When the object is at rest on the surface, only two forces act on it. They are the downward gravitational force and upward normal force. The resultant of these two forces on the object is zero.

questions.solution:

⇒ 0 = −2m + n

⇒ 2m = n

⇒ m ÷ n = 1 ÷ 2

∴ The correct answer is 1 : 2.

questions.question: The sum of a number and 4 times its reciprocal is 5. What is the number?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of a number and 4 times its reciprocal is 5. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Test the given options directly to find the number that satisfies the given condition:

For option (1), the number is 4.

Sum of 4 and 4 times its reciprocal = 4 + 4 × (1 ÷ 4) = 4 + 1 = 5.

This matches the given condition perfectly.

∴ The correct answer is 4.

Alternate Method

Let the unknown number be x.

According to the given problem:

⇒ x + 4 × (1 ÷ x) = 5

⇒ x + 4 ÷ x = 5

Multiplying the entire equation by x:

⇒ x2 + 4 = 5x

⇒ x2 − 5x + 4 = 0

Splitting the middle term to factorize:

⇒ x2 − 4x − x + 4 = 0

⇒ x(x − 4) − 1(x − 4) = 0

⇒ (x − 4)(x − 1) = 0

⇒ x = 4 or x = 1

Comparing with the given options, the value of the number is 4.

∴ The correct answer is 4.

Additional Information

Quadratic Equations

An equation of the form ax2 + bx + c = 0 can have at most two real roots. These roots can be determined either by factorization or by the quadratic formula.

Reciprocal Property

The reciprocal of a non-zero real number x is defined as 1 ÷ x. The product of a number and its reciprocal is always 1.

Subject (1) from (2)

5d = 15

a = -13 - 6 = -19

14th term will be given as

∴ The 14th term = 20

questions.question: If the amount received at the end of 2nd and 3rd year as Compound Interest on a certain Principal is Rs. 2100, and Rs. 2268 respectively, what is the rate (in %) of interest?

questions.solution:

Amount at the end of Second year = P(1 + R/100)2 = 2100      ----(1)

Amount at the end of third year = P(1 + R/100)3 = 2268      ----(2)

Divide (2) by (1)

[P(1 + R/100)3]/ [P(1 + R/100)2] = 2268/2100

⇒ 1 + R/100 = 2268/2100

⇒ 1 + R/100 = 27/25

⇒ R = (2/25) × 100

⇒ R = 8%

∴ The rate of interest = 8%

A person inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions
questions.solution:
Answer: Sceptic

Sceptic means a person inclined to question or doubt accepted opinions. Hence, it is the correct one-word substitute for the given phrase.

 Additional Information

Adherent: A supporter or follower.
Example sentence: Jane is an adherent of a healthy lifestyle and exercises regularly.

Zealot: An extremely passionate or fanatical person.
Example sentence: The football fan was a zealot, always wearing his team's jersey and cheering loudly at matches.

Disciple: A follower or student of a teacher or philosophy.
Example sentence: Sarah is a disciple of yoga and practices it daily to improve her flexibility and mindfulness.

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given. To Confront
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word similar in meaning to the word given.

To Confront
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. To Accost.

Key Points

  • The word "To Confront" means to face up to and deal with (a problem or difficult situation). (सामना करना)
    • Example: She had to confront her fears before she could move forward.
  • "To Accost" refers to approaching and addressing someone boldly or aggressively. (सामना करना)
    • Example: He was accosted by a stranger on the street.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. To Accost.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • To Avoid (टालना): Keep away from or stop oneself from doing (something).
    • Example: She tried to avoid making eye contact with the teacher.
  • To Dodge (बचना): Avoid (someone or something) by a sudden quick movement.
    • Example: He dodged the ball that was thrown at him.
  • To Yield (समर्पण करना): Give way to arguments, demands, or pressure.
    • Example: She yielded to the pressure and agreed to the terms.
